data_sources.weather: Las Vegas NV (lat=36.17, lon=-115.14) — NOT bundled; must be fetched from NRDB API
data_sources.observed_data: Scenario scaffolding (see README.md note); production values grounded in NREL PVWatts Las Vegas outputs

verification_notes: Best-fit criterion worth 20 points (highest weight). Agent must both run simulation AND provide root cause analysis/recommendations. Sweep pattern detection looks for loop structures over soiling and degradation arrays.
